Exports from the segment stood at ₹1,02,399.7 crore in FY26, compared with ₹1,02,002.8 crore in FY25, reflecting a modest growth of 0.4%.

Growth & demand: Global fibre demand is expected to reach around 149 million tonnes in 2030, with increasing population and growth in per-capita consumption.
